plan.notes: Source: Allegany College of Maryland Credit Catalog 2026-2027, Psychology (Area of Concentration) program path (https://catalog.allegany.edu/current/programs/psychology-aoc.pdf). 'Successful completion of this program qualifies a student to apply for an Associate of Science degree in Arts and Sciences - Area of Concentration in Psychology.' Caveats: (1) Footnote 1: 'Consult your advisor or Advising Center staff for appropriate courses' — applies to all Electives, English Elective, History Elective, Humanities Elective, Sociology Elective, Social and Behavioral Science Elective, Physical Activity. (2) Footnote 2: 'Students need to complete three courses from these courses: Psychology 110, 199, 203, 205, and 207' — the three Psychology Elective slots are modeled as choice slots with those options. Hand-transcribed 2026-10-01.
